items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...young trumpet players, say, might have been listening to Jabbo Smith or -- [INTERVIEWEE] Jabbo.

ctx.x: And when they heard -- when Wellman Braud saw that, he said he was through with the tuba. He had had the bass, and he started playing the bass. So what I was trying to get at was, you know, like young trumpet players, say, might have been listening to Jabbo Smith or --

-- King Oliver, Louis Armstrong or something, and I was wondering who you as a bassist were listening to or whether any guys were there that impressed you to where you emulated what they played or that you tried to figure out what they were playing.
